title: Gram determinant of the cylinder lift v ↦ (v_0, G(v_1, …, v_m))
statement:
Let P, m ∈ ℕ and G : ℝ^m → ℝ^P. For v ∈ ℝ^{m+1} write v_0 := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ v) 0 and tl(v) := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ v)) = (v_1, …, v_m). Let G̃ : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^{P+1} satisfy G̃(v) = (v_0, G(tl v)) for all v (Lean: Gt v = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m+1)) ℝ v 0) (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ (G (tl v))))). Let w ∈ ℝ^{m+1} and b = tl(w), and suppose G is differentiable at b. Then the Gram determinants of the derivatives on the standard bases agree:
det(⟨DG̃(w)e_i, DG̃(w)e_j⟩)_{i,j<m+1} = det(⟨DG(b)e′_i, DG(b)e′_j⟩)_{i,j<m},
where D = fderiv ℝ, e_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 ∈ ℝ^{m+1} and e′_i = EuclideanSpace.single i 1 ∈ ℝ^m.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (G : Eucl m → Eucl P) (Gt : Eucl (m + 1) → Eucl (P + 1)) (w : Eucl (m + 1)) (b : Eucl m), (∀ v : Eucl (m + 1), Gt v = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ v 0) (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ (G ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ v))))))) → b = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin m) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ w)) → DifferentiableAt ℝ G b → (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Gt w (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Gt w (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det = (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin m => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G b (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ G b (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det
